player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped the exploration prematurely after visiting only four rooms (Nursery, Balcony, Dining room, Wine cellar) without verifying if all reachable rooms were visited. Specifically, I did not check the "east" direction from the Dining room, which likely leads to an unvisited room. Next time, I will maintain a set of visited rooms and only declare "DONE" when the number of visited rooms equals the total number of unique rooms discovered so far. I will also ensure that every available direction provided by the Game Master is attempted before concluding the task, updating the graph's edges correctly with the current room as the source and the new room as the destination for each move.
